mods.title: Installed Mods
mods.subtitle: Identify local content and switch Mods on or off
mods.name: Mod
mods.list: Installed Mods for the selected game
mods.toggle_help: The switch describes file presence in a confirmed loading directory. In-game effects and compatibility need separate verification.
mods.local_only: Scanning stays on this PC. No files are downloaded, deleted or executed.
mods.partial_libraries: Some Steam libraries are unavailable. Existing records were retained; reconnect the drive and scan again.
mods.empty.title: See the Mods already in your games
mods.empty.body: Scan installed Steam games to find manageable Mods and content that needs confirmation.
mods.empty.search_body: Try a name or directory, or clear the search.
mods.empty.pending_body: Review {count} candidates under To confirm before enabling file management.
mods.empty.no_rules: No detection rule for this game yet
mods.empty.no_rules_body: This does not mean there are no Mods. Add a dedicated Mod directory inside the game installation.
mods.empty.partial: Some directories could not be scanned
mods.empty.none_body: This only describes the directories checked, not every file in the game.
mods.busy.load: Reading records and checking unfinished operations…
mods.busy.scan: Checking installation directories and ownership. You can cancel this scan.
mods.busy.enable: Restoring files. The switch updates after completion…
mods.busy.disable: Moving files out of the loading directory and recording their restore paths…
mods.confirm.title: Confirm Mod ownership
mods.confirm.body: Check that these complete, independent files belong to this Mod. Disabling moves them out of the loading directory. Configuration-controlled or merged Mods require dedicated support.
mods.confirm.consent: These files belong only to this Mod, and file presence controls loading.
mods.directory.title: Add a Mod directory rule
mods.directory.body: Choose a dedicated Mod subdirectory within the game installation. The whole game directory will not be adopted.
mods.directory.folders: Each subfolder is one independent Mod
mods.directory.packages: Group PAK / UTOC / UCAS files by package name
mods.directory.preview: Content under {root} will be detected using this structure. The rule stays on this PC.
mods.directory.consent: This directory contains independent Mods loaded by file presence, without shared loaders.
mods.reason.unconfirmed: A common Mod location was found. Confirm file ownership and the loading mechanism first.
mods.reason.files_changed: Files changed outside TrainerHub. Scan and review them; toggling is paused until confirmed.
mods.reason.files_missing: Recorded files are missing. Check the directory and scan again.
mods.reason.linked_files: Links, junctions or shared files were found, possibly controlled by another manager. Read-only.
mods.reason.external_manager: Another Mod manager's deployment record was found. Use the original manager.
mods.reason.shared_files: This may be a shared loader or merged output. It cannot be moved as an independent Mod.
mods.reason.configuration_required: Configuration also controls loading. This version does not support the required synchronization.
mods.reason.special_handling: Scripts or shared merge output need dedicated handling. Toggling is unavailable.
mods.reason.incomplete_package: A matching UTOC or UCAS file is missing; the package cannot be managed as a whole.
mods.reason.no_rules: No detection rule yet. Add a dedicated Mod directory.
mods.reason.unreadable: A directory or file could not be read. Check the drive and permissions, then scan again.
mods.reason.scan_limit: The directory exceeds scanning limits. Choose a smaller dedicated Mod directory.
mods.reason.unsafe_path: The path is outside the allowed scope or includes unsafe links or member names.
mods.reason.unsafe_root: Choose a dedicated Mod subdirectory, not the game root or original resource directory.
mods.reason.overlapping_rules: Overlapping rules claim the same files. Choose directories that do not overlap.
mods.reason.not_manageable: This item cannot be reliably toggled yet. Review its details and scan again.
mods.reason.destination_exists: The restore location already contains files. Nothing was overwritten; review both copies and scan again.
mods.reason.game_unavailable: The game installation is unavailable. Records were retained; reconnect the drive and scan again.
mods.reason.game_running: Exit the game before enabling or disabling Mods.
mods.reason.process_check_failed: The game process could not be checked. Exit the game and try again.
mods.reason.store_busy: Another TrainerHub is managing Mods. Wait for it to finish and retry.
mods.reason.store_corrupt: Mod records could not be read. Preserve the records and storage files; restore records from a backup.
mods.reason.recovery_required: An interrupted operation still needs recovery. Files and logs were retained; resolve conflicts or permissions, then scan to retry recovery.
mods.reason.operation_failed: The operation failed and restoration was attempted. Check file locks or permissions and scan again.

library.delete.confirm: Delete “{name}” and its files? This cannot be undone.
settings.title: Settings
settings.defender: Add the library folder to Defender exclusions
settings.defender.hint: Trainers rewrite game memory and are often flagged. This only touches the folder above and needs administrator rights.
settings.custom_source.hint: Accepts an array or {"items": []} — see the docs for field names.
settings.about.body: TrainerHub is an open-source manager that aggregates, downloads and archives single-player game trainers.
settings.about.disclaimer: Single-player, offline use only. This project ships no anti-cheat bypass of any kind.
wizard.welcome.body: Bring trainers scattered across sites into one window: search, download, auto-extract, archive and update.
wizard.disclaimer.title: Before you start
wizard.disclaimer.body: This tool targets single-player, offline games. Do not use third-party trainers in games with online components or in multiplayer modes.
wizard.library.title: Choose where to store trainers
wizard.library.body: Downloads are archived as source / game / version inside this folder.
wizard.sources.title: Pick your sources
wizard.sources.body: You can change this later in Settings.
wizard.sync.title: Building the index
wizard.sync.body: The first sync pulls the whole catalogue; later runs are incremental.
wizard.done.title: All set

dialog.updates.body: Select the ones to refresh; they will be downloaded and re-archived.

detail.remote_note: Live result from the source · not indexed yet

discovery.empty.title: Find trainers for your installed games
discovery.library.invalid: Invalid library data; previous results retained
settings.discovery.paths.hint: Steam root or library folders, separated by semicolons. Rescan manually after changing paths.
settings.discovery.clear.confirm: Clear scanned games, recommendations, exclusions and manual library paths, and disable discovery and launch rescanning? Games, trainers and download records will not be deleted.
settings.discovery.privacy: Scanning reads Steam libraries and manifests locally. Matching is local; game lists and install paths are not uploaded. Manual searches send the search term to enabled sources.
settings.discovery.matching: Matches game names and reliable local aliases. FLiNG is preferred for the same game; XiaoXing pages open separately. Owned trainers are not selected by default.
